id.instruksi: Dengarkan cuacanya, lalu sentuh kegiatan yang paling cocok.
id.t-cerah1: Langit cerah, tidak ada angin. Main apa yang cocok?
id.t-cerah2: Lapangan kering dan matahari bersinar. Main apa?
id.t-cerah3: Pantai cerah dan hangat, tidak hujan. Main apa?
id.t-cerah4: Matahari bersinar dan baju baru dicuci. Apa yang bisa dilakukan agar baju kering?
id.t-hujan1: Hujan turun tanpa guntur saat kamu menunggu bus. Di mana kamu bisa berteduh?
id.t-hujan2: Terdengar guntur dan terlihat kilat. Di mana kita bisa berlindung dengan aman?
id.t-hujan3: Hujan turun saat kita harus berjalan ke masjid. Apa yang dilakukan?
id.t-hujan4: Saat pulang sekolah, hujan turun tanpa guntur. Di mana kamu bisa menunggu sampai hujan reda?
id.t-angin1: Angin bertiup sedang di lapangan terbuka. Kegiatan mana yang memakai angin?
id.t-angin2: Angin sepoi-sepoi bertiup di kolam taman. Mainan apa yang memakai layar untuk menangkap angin?
id.t-angin3: Bendera berkibar pelan di lapangan terbuka. Main apa yang memanfaatkan angin?

en.judul: This Weather, What Shall We Do?
en.instruksi: Listen to the weather, then touch the activity that fits best.
en.i-halte: take shelter at the bus stop
en.i-sepeda: ride a bike in the park
en.i-pasir: play in the sand at the beach
en.t-cerah1: Clear sky, no wind at all. What fits?
en.t-cerah2: The field is dry and the sun is shining. What shall we play?
en.t-cerah3: The beach is sunny and warm, no rain. What shall we play?
en.t-cerah4: The sun is shining and your clothes have just been washed. What can you do to dry them?
en.t-hujan1: It starts raining without thunder while you wait for the bus. Where can you take shelter?
en.t-hujan2: You hear thunder and see lightning. Where can you take shelter safely?
en.t-hujan3: It rains while we must walk to the mosque. What do we do?
en.t-hujan4: It starts raining without thunder on the way home from school. Where can you wait for the rain to stop?
en.t-angin1: A steady breeze blows across an open field. Which activity uses the wind?
en.t-angin2: A light breeze blows over the park pond. Which toy uses a sail to catch the wind?
en.t-angin3: A flag flutters gently in an open field. Which activity uses the wind?
